AZ.summary_text: A perennially low-ranked facility whose ownership has been among the league's least willing to invest.
AZ.notes: NFLPA 2023-2025: Arizona repeatedly graded F in weight room, food/nutrition and family treatment; Bidwill ownership an F.

ATL.summary_text: A Blank-owned franchise with strong facilities and above-average investment across the board.
ATL.notes: Arthur Blank consistently grades near the top on ownership investment; Flowery Branch facilities rate well.

BAL.summary_text: A solid, stable organization with a respected head coach and middle-to-upper facility grades.
BAL.notes: Bisciotti ownership rates B/B+; Harbaugh among the higher-graded head coaches in player surveys.

BUF.summary_text: Pegula ownership invests steadily; a well-regarded head coach and above-average support staff.
BUF.notes: Buffalo rates above average in most NFLPA categories; ownership and coaching are strengths.

CAR.summary_text: Tepper's deep pockets haven't translated to top survey grades; food and family treatment lag.
CAR.notes: Carolina is among the league's wealthiest owners but grades below league average on nutrition and family treatment.

CHI.summary_text: Halas Hall is solid but unspectacular; ownership investment trails the franchise's market size.
CHI.notes: The renovated Halas Hall rates average; McCaskey ownership grades C-range.

CIN.summary_text: Long the league's lowest-graded organization; food, family treatment and the weight room lag badly.
CIN.notes: Cincinnati has finished at or near the bottom of the NFLPA report card every year; Mike Brown ownership grades F.

CLE.summary_text: Adequate facilities and support, with ownership grading below the wealthy owners around the league.
CLE.notes: Haslam ownership rates C-range; facilities at Berea are middle-of-the-pack.

DAL.summary_text: The Jones family spends: elite facilities and support staff across nearly every category.
DAL.notes: Dallas is a perennial top-5 report card; the head-coach grade trails the facility grades.

DEN.summary_text: Walton-Penner's $175M facility rebuild and a top coach put Denver near the top of the league.
DEN.notes: Denver's ownership wealth is among the league's largest; the new facility grades near the top.

DET.summary_text: A much-improved culture and one of the league's most popular head coaches lift middling facilities.
DET.notes: Dan Campbell grades among the top head coaches; Ford ownership is cash-constrained but steady.

GB.summary_text: A well-run public franchise whose travel setup has historically been its weakest survey mark.
GB.notes: Green Bay's travel grade has lagged (no first-class seating, roommates required) despite otherwise strong marks.

HOU.summary_text: A consistently above-average organization, particularly strong on family treatment.
HOU.notes: Houston grades well on family treatment and travel; McNair ownership is steady.

IND.summary_text: Middle-of-the-pack facilities and support; ownership grades slightly below the strong owners.
IND.notes: Irsay ownership rates C+; Indianapolis is average across most NFLPA categories.

JAX.summary_text: Khan's spending hasn't fixed the food and family categories, which repeatedly grade poorly.
JAX.notes: Jacksonville has a good plane (travel B+) but F/D grades on nutrition and family treatment in recent surveys.

KC.summary_text: A top coach and culture; ownership investment lags behind the on-field dynasty.
KC.notes: Andy Reid grades at or near the top; Clark Hunt's ownership has graded C for willingness to invest.

LAC.summary_text: A strong coach and a new El Segundo facility, undercut by a low-graded ownership.
LAC.notes: Spanos ownership grades D; the new training facility improved the physical categories.

LAR.summary_text: Kroenke's SoFi-era spending and McVay's reputation make the Rams a destination.
LAR.notes: Los Angeles is a perennial top-10 report card with elite facilities and a top-rated head coach.

LV.summary_text: Cash-poor ownership that nonetheless built a top-tier Henderson facility; the grade split reflects it.
LV.notes: Mark Davis is Tier 4 wealth but the Raiders' new headquarters grades near the top; coaching and family trail.

MIA.summary_text: Repeatedly the league's No. 1 overall grade; elite across the board.
MIA.notes: Miami has topped the NFLPA report card in multiple seasons; Stephen Ross ownership grades A+.

MIN.summary_text: The model franchise for player treatment: top marks in travel, family and facilities.
MIN.notes: Minnesota ranked No. 1 in 2025 with A/A+ grades in travel, family treatment, facilities and nutrition.

NE.summary_text: The AirKraft jets and strong ownership grade well, though facilities are slightly older.
NE.notes: New England's team travel (AirKraft 767s, no roommates) is a consistent A; Kraft ownership A-.

NO.summary_text: A solid but unremarkable organization, with food and nutrition grading slightly better than the rest.
NO.notes: New Orleans is middle-of-the-pack in most categories; Benson ownership rates B-.

NYG.summary_text: A storied franchise with aging facilities and middle-tier investment grades.
NYG.notes: The Giants grade average across facilities; Mara/Tisch ownership is Tier 4 wealth.

NYJ.summary_text: Adequate facilities in Florham Park, with ownership and coaching grading lower.
NYJ.notes: Woody Johnson ownership grades C; the Jets are average on facilities and below average on coaching/family.

PHI.summary_text: Lurie's investment keeps Philadelphia near the top in facilities, food and family treatment.
PHI.notes: Philadelphia is a consistent top-10 report card; ownership, coaching and facilities all grade A-range.

PIT.summary_text: A first-rate head coach and culture, but a family-trust ownership that grades low on investment.
PIT.notes: Mike Tomlin grades near the top; the Rooney family is Tier 4 wealth with a C ownership grade.

SEA.summary_text: The Paul Allen trust's wealth backs strong facilities and a highly regarded head coach.
SEA.notes: Seattle's ownership is among the league's wealthiest; facilities and travel grade above average.

SF.summary_text: Santa Clara facilities and Shanahan's reputation make the 49ers a strong destination.
SF.notes: San Francisco grades A-range on facilities and coaching; York ownership rates B.

TB.summary_text: A consistent, middle-of-the-pack organization across every category.
TB.notes: Tampa Bay is average across the NFLPA survey; Glazer ownership rates B.

TEN.summary_text: An average organization with a new stadium facility on the horizon.
TEN.notes: Tennessee grades around league average; Strunk ownership rates C+.

WAS.summary_text: New ownership is improving things, but legacy facilities and support still trail the league.
WAS.notes: Washington graded F under Snyder; the Harris ownership era is raising the marks but the physical plant still lags.
